title: Multimodal LLM agents
reading: A single figure carries this slide, sketching the basic agent loop around a central LLM call with a human in the loop, an environment, and a termination path.

visuals.description: Central green 'LLM Call' box. Dashed bidirectional arrow to a 'Human' pill on the left; dashed arrow down to a 'Stop' box; curved arrows to/from an 'Environment' pill on the right labelled 'Action' (outgoing) and 'Feedback' (incoming).
visuals.assertion: An LLM agent operates as a loop: the LLM issues actions to an environment and receives feedback, optionally exchanging information with a human, and terminates by emitting a stop decision.

concepts.name: LLM agent loop
concepts.why_it_matters: Defines the action–feedback cycle that distinguishes agents from single-shot LLM calls.

concepts.name: Human-in-the-loop
concepts.why_it_matters: Allows steering or approval during agent execution.

concepts.name: Termination / stop condition
concepts.why_it_matters: Agents need an explicit halting criterion.
